description:
Secure remote access and support.

TeamViewer is a comprehensive, remote access, remote control and remote support solution that works with almost every desktop and mobile platform, including Windows. It lets you remote in to computers or mobile devices located anywhere in the world and use them as though you were there.
New Features
- The TeamViewer Full and Host MSI packages now support localization in multiple languages.
- The TeamViewer Full and Host MSI packages now allow users to choose whether to keep or remove their settings during uninstallation.

Improvements
- Fixed a bug where deleted chat conversations could reappear after restarting the application. Chat messages are now marked as read more efficiently, ensuring chat history changes are handled correctly and consistently.
- The remote session side panel has been improved by allowing the minimized panel to be repositioned vertically, helping prevent it from covering content on the remote device.

Bugfixes
- Fixed a bug in the in‑session chat that caused the account picture to flicker while typing a message.
- Fixed a bug in Voice over IP (VoIP) that could cause TeamViewer to quit unexpectedly.
- Fixed a bug in the in‑session toolbar where the “Ctrl+Alt+Del” action did not work correctly when connecting to a macOS device.
- Fixed a DLL sideloading vulnerability that could lead to local privilege escalation (Security Bulletin: TV-2026-XXXX) (Security Bulletin: TV-2026-1012).
- Fixed a command injection vulnerability leading to local privilege escalation in Advanced Asset Management (Security Bulletin: TV-2026-1012).
- Fixed an improper access control vulnerability that could lead to local privilege escalation (Security Bulletin: TV-2026-1012).
- Fixed a memory corruption vulnerability that could lead to application termination or RCE (Security Bulletin: TV-2026-1011).
